title: Don't Craft
description: DontCraft is a simple Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that completely disables the crafting table. Players can still place and break crafting tables, but right-clicking them will no longer open the crafting interface.
body: DontCraft is a simple Forge mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that completely disables the crafting table. Players can still place and break crafting tables, but right-clicking them will no longer open the crafting interface. Perfect for challenge maps, hardcore survival, custom modpacks, and unique gameplay experiences where crafting must be done in other ways.
